Four documented Citiz stations compared with five Reunion communes

Eybens Mairie, Eybens Odyssée, Pélussin Place Abbé Vincent and ArchParc Communauté de communes versus a 200 m grid in Saint-Denis, Saint-Pierre, Saint-Paul, Le Port and Saint-Benoît.

Partial scoring-v2 test (3 indicators out of 4): the score compares population, population density and the share of no-car households. Candidate centres are restricted to populated Filosofi 2019 cells, but RP 2023 values are still allocated by IRIS area. Employment, BPE-based activity intensity and peak transit accessibility are absent. This is similarity to the closest physical reference, not predicted demand or success.
